MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The component tester, trimpots, and adjustable power supply help me build, tune, and troubleshoot circuits, which connects directly to my breadboards, PCB supplies, and relay module.",
    "The Arduino environmental sensors feel like a plausible next experiment because they connect my circuit-building interests with my past interest in temperature measurement."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Brass lathe stock, a magnetic measurement base, and thread gauges assume machining needs that my occasional practical hardware purchases do not establish.",
    "The load cell fits my Arduino interests, but I have no weighing project in mind; a compatible component alone is not enough to make me choose it now.",
    "The other two power supplies suit my interests, but choosing one already meets my current need, so I would skip the duplicates."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical hardware seems to have been stretched into an interest in specialized machining supplies.",
    "My use of Arduino-compatible parts seems to have been treated as a reason to want any Arduino project, regardless of what it measures or accomplishes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Tools and components that support several circuit-building tasks feel more immediately useful to me than parts requiring a specific new project.",
    "Several suitable power supplies represent one purchase need for me, not several separate purchases.",
    "My caster purchase reflects an occasional hardware need, while my repeated breadboard, PCB, and relay purchases give a clearer picture of my electronics interests."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my electronics interests but stretched occasional hardware purchases into machining needs and Arduino compatibility into project intent."
}
